requirements.title: Logical intrinsic operations express logical computations and produce logical results
requirements.definition: A logical intrinsic operation expresses a logical computation and, when evaluated, produces a result of type logical. The permitted operand types are not redefined here; they are the logical operand rules specified in 10.1.5.1.

pending.logical-computation-context: PENDING  positive-control source plan using an intrinsic logical operation in a logical assignment or IF context with literal operands. The plan observes the operation's logical computation result and credits expression grammar to 10.1.2.8.
pending.logical-result-type: PENDING  positive-control source plan applying .NOT. or .EQV. to logical operands and passing the result to a LOGICAL dummy or KIND inquiry. The plan observes type LOGICAL, not representation bits.
pending.operand-type-delegation: PENDING  source-use plan records that permitted logical operand types are owned by S10.1.5.1-005. Any nonlogical operand diagnostic/control belongs there unless this subclause's interpretation is the only failing property.

requirements.oracle: Use only literal logical values or standard logical inquiries. Truth-table controls must not contain operand side effects, function-call counters, undefined branches, or any assertion that .AND. or .OR. skipped an operand; Fortran does not require short-circuit evaluation. Grouping of an associative intrinsic logical operation is not value-observable, so any future grouping witness must be a valid non-associative defined extension attributed to 10.1.6 and 15.4.3.4.2.
requirements.oracle_limitation: This source-only catalogue records pending plans only. It creates no Fortran test program, invokes no processor, approves no fixture or oracle, and claims no coverage. Future fixtures must use independently derived literal, inquiry, or source-repair oracles and must not infer evaluation order, short-circuiting, which operand was evaluated, or whether an operand was evaluated. They must not rely on compiler agreement, address arithmetic, TRANSFER, emitted assembly, undefined reads, or a floating-point result that 10.1.7 or 10.1.8 permits to differ through omitted evaluation or mathematically equivalent rewriting.

requirements.title: .NOT. is logical negation
requirements.source: 10.1.5.4.1 Table 10.5 .NOT. row and Table 10.6 .NOT. column; J3/24-007 PDF p179.
requirements.definition: The logical intrinsic operator .NOT. is a unary logical negation; .NOT. x2 is true if x2 is false and false if x2 is true.

review_rationale: batch102: independent fresh-context source review against pinned J3/24-007 (sha256 7371e889...), including verification of the correction commit. Reviewer read 10.1.5.4.1 p1-p3 and Tables 10.5-10.6, 10.1.5.4.2 p1-p2 and its note, 10.1.5.5.1 p1-p10 with its notes and Table 10.7, and 10.1.5.5.2 p1-p2 and its note, all in the original PDF rather than the author summary, and verified 24 base / 70 fine units. Tables 10.5, 10.6 and 10.7 were checked row by row; the < = and > = forms in Table 10.7 are PDF extraction artefacts for <= and >=, not distinct operators. The first pass returned blocked with three findings, all closed by a correction commit and re-verified: C10LR-001 and C10LR-002 reclassified the 10.1.5.4.2 p1 and 10.1.5.5.2 p1 alternative-evaluation sentences from effect requirements to processor permissions, since each says the processor may evaluate any logically or relationally equivalent expression - the parenthesis-integrity limit and the NaN limit survive as boundaries of those permissions, and nothing in the packet now asserts a rewrite was or was not performed. C10LR-003 removed logical from the relational operand literal list in 14 places, because 10.1.5.5.1 NOTE 1 and Table 10.2 do not admit two logical operands to a relational intrinsic operation, so such a positive control would not even be conforming. Closeout confirmed complete unit accounting, unchanged hashes, rendered views matching the JSON, no dangling or reused requirement identifiers, and gates green. Final decision: accept, no blocking findings. This registers source accounting only: it is not fixture approval, it supplies no execution, and it approves no value oracle.
